context: 4 fun-maximizing features, each targeting a different engagement lever: skill expression, urgency, surprise, visual impact.

features.1_mission_combo: Consecutive correct mission answers build a streak (resets on wrong answer), each level adds 5 percent to the reward, capped at streak 10 (50 percent bonus). Shown as a fire-emoji combo count in the toast.
features.2_golden_crop: Roughly every 10 seconds, 20 percent chance an empty farm plot gets a 25-second glowing golden crop, visible on the map and in the farm menu. Claiming grants 800-2000G with the existing jackpot celebration animation. Missing it just makes it vanish, no penalty.
features.3_lucky_hour: One random hour per day (derived deterministically from the date, no server storage needed) doubles harvest and mission rewards, with a pulsing banner at the top while active.
features.4_juice: Screen-shake on car collision (targets the canvas specifically to avoid a conflicting transform rule on gameShell), confetti burst on every level-up.

verification.golden_crop_tested: Real navigation to the farm, claimed the golden crop, confirmed gold increased in the expected range and the state cleared afterward.
verification.combo_tested: Answered a known-correct mission option, confirmed the reward matched the expected combo math exactly and the streak counter incremented.
verification.visual_effects_tested: Directly triggered both animations, confirmed they are recognized and applied with zero page errors.
verification.regression_suite: Graph integrity, stuck-node escape, speed equalization, and standard playthrough all pass.
